data.body: A navigation object is a menu — header or footer — of groups and items. The site singleton names which navigation objects are its defaults.

Body fields

  • tracking
  • role (required)
  • brand
  • groups (required)
  • actions
  • footNote

Patch operations

  • set_nav_meta
  • upsert_group
  • move_group
  • remove_group
  • upsert_item
  • update_item
  • move_item
  • remove_item
  • upsert_action
  • remove_action
  • set_tracking

This reference is generated from the live object_contract. If it disagrees with the contract, the manual is wrong and the drift guard fails the build of it.

Worked example

nav_header uses page-kind targets for published README pages; nav_footer groups operational, reference, and example links. Navigation publishes only when page targets already exist and are published.

Lifecycle note

Groups cannot be empty, menu depth is bounded, and duplicate targets warn without blocking legitimate designs.
